rule: Test a settings writer over repeated add and remove cycles through the real MCP operations, and look for the fix in newer releases of a misbehaving library before working around it (principle 13).
check: pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts apps/desktop/src/engine/settings/__tests__/mcp-configuration.test.ts -t 'same size across add and remove'
